results.title: Linda Yaccarino steps down from role as CEO of Musk-owned X - ABC News
results.content:
Linda Yaccarino steps down from role as CEO of Musk-owned X
Linda Yaccarino said she is stepping down from her role as CEO of X, the social media platform owned by Elon Musk.
Yaccarino, who previously served as an advertising executive at NBCUniversal, took the helm of X two years ago.
Musk, the wealthiest person in the world, who runs Tesla and Space X, named Yaccarino as CEO in May 2023, just months after Musk acquired X in a $44 billion deal.

On May 11, 2023, Musk tweeted that he had found his replacement as Twitter and X Corp.'s CEO.
Musk said he would transition his role to executive chairman and chief technology officer.
In August 2023, CEO Linda Yaccarino stated that she has "operational autonomy" under owner Elon Musk to run the business, and that she is involved in everything that goes into running the company.

results.title: Elon Musk says Tesla ending Models S and X production
results.content:
Tesla CEO Elon Musk said on Wednesday that the automaker is ending production of its Model S and X vehicles, and will use the factory in Fremont, California, to build Optimus humanoid robots.
Tesla debuted more affordable versions of the vehicles late last year.
Musk said on the call that Tesla is replacing its production line for S and X in Fremont "with a 1 million unit per year line of Optimus."
